name: Shirakawa Nanaka
source:
Likes: Music, hats, playing pranks on people
Dislikes: Boring stuff, studying

According to unconfirmed information, Nanaka is a "2nd cousin once removed" of [url=https://vndb.org/c4014]Kotori Shirakawa[/url] by her father's bloodline. Nanaka is a school idol. She is the lead singer of the school band formed with [url=https://vndb.org/c4049]Koko[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c4056]Wataru[/url]. She prefers the "haptic" kind of communication, taking the hand of a person with whom she talks. Doing so, she confuses guys and makes the enemies among the girls. Of course, this girl, as well as others, could not avoid the fate of falling in love with [url=https://vndb.org/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url]. And Nanaka knows, that Koko, her best friend, has the same feelings for him. Friendship, love, hate... What else Shirakawa and Sakurai have to experience, before they will be able to sing their song for the [url=https://vndb.org/c5971]little girl[/url] who dies slowly in the hospital?
